_comment: Ground truth, checked by hand against each resume. test/accuracy.test.mjs fails if the parser finds a skill that is not here (a false positive), misses one that is (a miss), or reports different months. Add a row whenever a new resume style is added.

sample-resume.txt.note: Dated internship, dated research post, two semester-dated projects, a comma skills list.

style-semester.txt.note: Semester dates across an academic year, an inline skills heading, bullet glyphs.

style-numeric.txt.note: Numeric date ranges, headings ending in a colon, no projects section.

style-sparse.txt.note: Skills mentioned only in prose, no dates anywhere.
